traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

effects.reason: a rest-triggered resource flag; the resource itself is a boolean on the character

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose a lineage (Drow, High Elf, Wood Elf): a level 1 benefit and a spell learned at levels 3 and 5.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep and magic can't put you to sleep; you finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of trance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a Bonus Action you gain Tremorsense (60 ft) for 10 minutes while on or touching a stone surface; uses equal to your proficiency bonus per Long Rest.
